title: Interior smoothness and zero-variance geometry for finite-maturity Heston American puts
abstract: arXiv:2610.20000v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study finite-maturity American puts in the Heston model without the Feller condition. At positive variance, the exercise boundary is smooth and strictly decreasing in remaining maturity and variance. At zero variance, the endpoint is locally Lipschitz in remaining maturity, the boundary moves with bounded speed in maturity uniformly down to zero variance, and it extends continuously to the axis. Each boundary slice at positive maturity has a regular $C^1$ closure tangent to the zero-variance axis, its stock threshold has variance derivative tending to minus infinity, and both partial derivatives of the inverse boundary graph vanish along the slice. The continuation premium at the axis contact stock is of order variance, and as a consequence smooth fit fails in the variance direction at the axis. At expiry the whole boundary, including its axis edge, converges to the strike. We give quantitative boundary gap bounds, an exact limiting w

translated_title: 有限到期Heston美式看跌期权的内部光滑性与零方差几何
translated_abstract: 我们研究在不满足Feller条件的Heston模型中的有限到期美式看跌期权。在方差为正处，行权边界是光滑的，且关于剩余到期时间与方差严格递减。在方差为零处，端点关于剩余到期时间局部Lipschitz，边界以一致有界的速度随到期时间移动直至零方差，并连续延拓到坐标轴上。每个正到期时间处的边界切片都具有正则的 $C^1$ 闭包并与零方差轴相切，其股票阈值关于方差的导数趋于负无穷，且逆边界图像的两个偏导数沿该切片均为零。在轴接触股票处的延续溢价为方差的量级，因此在轴处光滑拟合在方差方向上失效。在到期时，整个边界（包括其轴边缘）收敛到行权价。我们给出了定量的边界间距界以及精确的极限……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在无Feller条件下完整刻画了有限到期Heston美式看跌期权行权边界在正方差处的光滑性及在零方差处的几何形态，证明边界连续延拓并与零方差轴相切，且光滑拟合在方差方向上失效。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the interior smoothness of the exercise boundary at positive variance and characterizes its zero-variance geometry for finite-maturity Heston American puts without the Feller condition, proving continuous tangential extension of the boundary to the variance axis and failure of smooth fit in the variance direction.
